name: Frank Lautenberg
summary:
Frank Raleigh Lautenberg (; January 23, 1924 –  June 3, 2013) was an American businessman and Democratic Party politician who served as United States Senator from New Jersey from 1982 to 2001, and again from 2003 until his death in 2013. He was originally from Paterson, New Jersey.
Lautenberg was elected to five terms as Senator.
